name: bhai
description: bh-ai — an offline-first macOS assistant with shared project memory for coding agents, English and Hinglish commands, and local MCP integration.

scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/index.tsx --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome132 --outfile=dist/renderer/renderer.bundle.js && mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html && cp src/renderer/styles.css dist/renderer/styles.css
scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p .cache/swift dist/native && swiftc -module-cache-path .cache/swift src/native/bhai_helper.swift -O -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 -o dist/native/bhai-helper
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:helper
